**T-4 Bearing Seal Failure:** On 14 March 2025, Turbine T-4 suffered a corroded-through bearing seal allowing seawater into the nacelle, causing the only multi-week outage of the pilot, with the root cause traced to corrosion of the bearing seal housing. The lead engineer recommended replacing the titanium fastener set with duplex stainless steel across all remaining nacelles, which the steering group accepted in principle.

**Energy Output:** Over the 24-month operating period, the pilot delivered **18.7 GWh**—6% below the original forecast of 19.9 GWh.

**Budget Outcome:** Final cost was **EUR 41.25 million** against an approved budget of EUR 36.7 million, an overrun of EUR 4.55 million (12.4%), driven mainly by the T-4 repair campaign.

**Environmental Finding:** An independent fish-monitoring program found **no statistically significant change** in fish migration counts before and after installation (p = 0.41).

**Final Decision:** The steering group **approved Phase 2 for Q3 2026**, contingent on a completed bearing seal redesign and a successful dry-dock endurance test.
